name: Craftsman's Writ - Greater Arcane Protection Potion
label: Quest
description: Craftsman's Writ - Greater Arcane Protection Potion: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.
All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Packmaster Stonebruiser pops open one of the greater arcane protection potions and take a swig.
WOOT! These pack a kick, baby! A kick I say!
